professionalSummary: Controls software engineer with six years of experience designing, writing, and commissioning PLC and line‑control software for conveyor and sortation lines. Holds a Higher National Diploma in Electrical and Electronic Engineering and has performed safety function implementation and verification in collaboration with safety engineers. Proven track record of producing as‑built documentation and commissioning records in line with company standards.
experienceHighlights: Wrote PLC and line‑control software for eleven lines against mechanical designs under company software standards (src_6758d443c8fb).
Commissioned nine lines on site with installation teams, recording results in commissioning records (src_e90b9f320220).
Implemented safety functions per safety engineer specifications; safety function verifications signed by qualified safety engineer (src_0face072df96).
Produced as‑built software documentation and control software boundary notes for all eleven lines, filed with hand‑over packs (src_39cf61becfa3).
projectsAndWorkSamples: Provided work sample of line‑control software listing, as‑built documentation, and commissioning record for one sortation line, along with diploma certificate (src_e68518a9da0b).
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume, work sample, and notes establish the candidate’s experience, education, and specific tasks related to the role, but do not confirm completion of an accredited engineering degree or direct signing of safety function verifications by the candidate.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate demonstrates relevant experience but lacks evidence of an accredited engineering degree and direct signing of safety function verifications; human review required.

evidence.text: Higher National Diploma in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, 2017; final-year top-up to the honours award started in 2019, not completed.
evidence.notes: Diploma is a technical qualification but not an accredited engineering degree.

evidence.text: LinkedIn education section reads 'BEng Electrical and Electronic Engineering'.

missingEvidence: Evidence of completion of an accredited engineering degree (e.g., BEng, MEng, or equivalent).

evidence.text: Safety functions on each line were implemented by me to the safety engineer's specification; the safety function verification was signed by the safety engineer, who holds the required qualification.
evidence.notes: Verification signed by safety engineer, not by candidate.

missingEvidence: Evidence that the candidate personally signed the safety function verifications.

evidence.text: Controls technician, then controls software engineer, on conveyor and sortation lines for a materials handling company for six years, writing the PLC and line-control software for eleven lines against the mechanical designs under the company's software standard.
Commissioned nine of those lines on site with the installation teams, recording the commissioning results in the line commissioning records.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of commissioning and recording.

evidence.text: Wrote the as-built software documentation and the control software boundary notes for the eleven lines, filed with each line's hand-over pack.

supportedClaims.claim: Controls software engineer with six years of experience designing, writing, and commissioning PLC and line‑control software for conveyor and sortation lines.
supportedClaims.witness: Controls technician, then controls software engineer, on conveyor and sortation lines for a materials handling company for six years, writing the PLC and line-control software for eleven lines against the mechanical designs under the company's software standard.

supportedClaims.claim: Produced as‑built software documentation and control software boundary notes for all eleven lines.
supportedClaims.witness: Wrote the as-built software documentation and the control software boundary notes for the eleven lines, filed with each line's hand-over pack.

unsupportedClaims.claim: Candidate holds an accredited engineering degree in electrical, electronic or control engineering.
unsupportedClaims.reason: Only a Higher National Diploma and an incomplete honours top‑up are documented; no evidence of a completed accredited degree.
unsupportedClaims.requiredFollowUp: Provide official degree certificate or transcript confirming completion of an accredited engineering degree.

unsupportedClaims.claim: Candidate personally signed safety function verifications for conveyor or sortation lines.
unsupportedClaims.reason: Evidence shows safety engineer signed the verifications; no record of candidate’s signature.
unsupportedClaims.requiredFollowUp: Provide signed safety function verification documents or witness statements confirming candidate’s signature.

missingEvidenceGaps.gap: Completion of an accredited engineering degree (BEng/MEng or equivalent).
Candidate’s signature on safety function verification documents.

interviewSignalRisks.text: Candidate said he has 'an engineering degree in electrical' and described the diploma and the top-up as 'the same thing in practice'; asked whether the top-up was completed, he said it was 'on hold'.
interviewSignalRisks.recommendedHandling: Verify official degree status and clarify distinction between diploma and honours top‑up.

followUpQuestions.question: Can you provide official documentation confirming completion of an accredited engineering degree in electrical, electronic, or control engineering?
Could you share copies of safety function verification documents that bear your signature?
followUpQuestions.evidenceTarget: Signed verification documents or witness statements.

humanReviewChecklist: Confirm candidate’s educational qualification status; verify that the candidate signed safety function verifications; assess whether the incomplete honours top‑up satisfies the degree requirement; evaluate overall fit based on documented experience.

Human review is needed to resolve these gaps before a hiring decision can be made.
limitations: Evidence limited to provided resume, work sample, and recruiter notes; no external verification of degree or signatures.
